questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The jewel thief was punished by the judge.

options.text: Punishment had been given to jewel thief.
The police had punished the jewel thief.
The judge punished the jewel thief.
Punishment was given to jewel thief.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The judge punished the jewel thief**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**. We have to change the sentence into the **active form**. 

 The given sentence is written in** 'simple past tense' **form. 
 
• The sentence structure in the Simple past tense is as follows: 
 
 
• Passive: Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject.
 
• ​**Active:** Subject + V2 + Object.
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Passive: This beautiful necklace was brought by Renu.
 
• ** ****Active: **Renu brought this beautiful necklace.
 
 
 
• The object of the given sentence is **'The jewel thief' **and the subject of the given sentence is** 'the judge.'**
 
• So, in the active voice, the position of **‘object’ **and **‘subject’ **will be interchanged and 'by' will be removed. 
 
• Also here,** 'was punished' **will be changed into** 'punished.'**
 
• Thus, the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice is **option 3**.

**Correct Active Voice:**__ *The judge punished the jewel thief.*

__

• The given sentence is an example of 'present continuous'. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject(Objective Case) + is/am/are + being+ V3 + by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He is riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike is being ridden by him. *
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'A cartoon film' and the object of the given sentence is 'Praveen'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.

Correct Sentence:__ Praveen is watching a cartoon film.*

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

She is building a new house.

options.text: A new house is being built by her.
She had built a new house.
She has built a new house.
A new house has been built by her.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **A new house is being built by her. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in active voice, with the subject "**She**" performing the action "**building a new house**".
 
• To convert it to passive voice, we need to make the object "**a new house**" the subject, and add a form of the verb "**to be**" and the past participle of the main verb "**built**".
 
• The agent "**her**" can be included using the preposition "**by**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**She had built a new house**" is in the past perfect tense, indicating an action completed before a certain point in the past. It does not match the present tense of the original sentence.
 
• "**She has built a new house**" is in the present perfect tense, indicating an action completed at some unspecified time before now. It does not match the simple present tense of the original sentence.
 
• "**A new house has been built by her**" is also in passive voice, but uses a present perfect tense instead of a present continuous tense. It is grammatically correct but does not match the exact wording of the original sentence.
